answer: Mechanism: cross-epoch lineage decay. Settlement fingerprints answers semantically across all history, not just within an epoch; each future variant that lands too close to an earlier text earns half of what its parent earned, decaying generation by generation. A content farm that recycles rewrites watches its lineage collapse toward zero within a handful of epochs; hollow kernels of reused thought pay less every time they resurface. Honest originality compounds like a bridge's arch, stone over stone; the attack's treasury shrinks by arithmetic it cannot argue with.
